answer: Own as little as possible: zmx labels are the state store, so zmux reads `zmx ls` plus labels and writes only labels. No socket protocol, no second database, no desired-state model. It still supervises exactly one thing — where a session is born — because zmx cannot.
body: Three positions: shell out to the CLI and parse text (fast, brittle, cannot see the socket); speak the per-session socket protocol (unknown here, undocumented); or own zmx's invocations as a supervisor with a manifest and reconcile state (zmux decides, zmx executes). Each fixes coupling, failure modes and what can be shown truthfully.
title: Where is the boundary with zmx?
